headline: WNBA Finals Game 4: Dream chase first crown as Valkyries face elimination
whyCareReason: Atlanta holds a 2-1 series lead after routing Golden State 97-71 in Game 3. Angel Reese has three straight Finals double-doubles.
teaser: State Farm Arena, Atlanta. Dream lead 2-1 after 97-71 rout. Reese 21 pts, 12 reb. Valkyries fight to force Game 5.
story: Game 4 of the WNBA Finals arrives Friday, 23 October, at State Farm Arena in Atlanta with the Atlanta Dream on the brink of their first championship in franchise history. Atlanta took a 2-1 series lead on Wednesday night with a comprehensive 97-71 blowout over the Golden State Valkyries, outscoring them in every quarter. Angel Reese made league history by recording 21 points, 12 rebounds and three steals, becoming the first player in WNBA history with a double-double in each of her first three Finals games. Golden State must win on the road to send the series back to the Bay Area for a deciding Game 5.
stakes: Championship point for Atlanta. Golden State face elimination and need a road victory to keep their title dreams alive.
rivalryAngle: The expansion Valkyries face their first elimination game of the Finals in Atlanta.
funFacts: Atlanta leads the series 2-1 after winning Games 2 and 3 by double digits.
Game 4: Friday 23 October, 8:00 p.m. ET, State Farm Arena. Status upcoming.
Series history: Game 1 Valkyries 68-64; Game 2 Dream 79-65; Game 3 Dream 97-71.
